value.signature: fn safe_open (path : & Path) -> io :: Result < File >

review.body: { if let Some (parent) = path . parent () && ! parent . as_os_str () . is_empty () && ! parent . exists () { create_dir_all (parent) ? ; } File :: create (path) }
review.item_premise: This body inherits the public-execwrap decision for safe_open.
